learner_operation: For each displayed equation, collect variable terms on the left and constants on the right without scaling the equation; identify implicit unit and missing zero coefficients; select the matrix whose coefficient columns and final constant column match every row.

fixed_features.feature: Natural variable order and displayed equation order; coefficients then RHS constants
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial f6081e68-9014-5a0d-a6bf-084abe5fd28e specifies natural order; tutorial 36b1a271-77b9-59ed-9f12-1b6675c26830 defines augmentation.

fixed_features.feature: Two equations in x,y for easy; single radio field with five matrix choices
fixed_features.justification: All five easy assessed sources use this workload and all ten assessed sources use five-choice radio; no source supports solving the system as the response.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Signs and magnitudes may change independently while dependent prompt, bank, key and solution are recomputed. Particular source sign masks are incidental.
answer_roles.observed: Four distinct answer sign masks in each of ten fresh normal profile samples; 32 targeted repeated-unit cases, both formerly failing unit signs, and 20 signed boundaries pass.

answer_roles.role: Which displayed equation/variable carries a missing term or needs transposition
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Permute equation and variable roles within existing term-side patterns, keeping natural matrix column convention.
answer_roles.observed: Equation/variable assignments recorded per profile; fixed-data x/y role counterfactual moves the missing zero and changes prompt, answer, explanation and native accepted selection together.

answer_roles.role: Correct option position and distractor error locations
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any five-radio position; distractors may corrupt different source-scope entry placements or magnitudes.

counterfactuals.change: At fixed seed 941713401 and constant literal 4, replace coefficient literal 2 by 1,-1,2 in q-71722.
counterfactuals.expected: Different displayed coefficients require three different augmented matrices, explanations and accepted choices; units must not be rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: All three render correctly and all five responses per record native-graded. Strict exact +/-1 old witnesses fail archived 2.0.0 and pass current 2.0.1.

counterfactuals.justification: The response depends on collected signed coefficients, not on template identity.

counterfactuals.justification: Source 64fc376d-990c-50f9-82bf-f8e85e2ed45f tests a missing-variable zero; which variable is missing is incidental.

counterfactuals.change: Reverse commutative term order on one equation side while preserving all coefficient and constant values.

counterfactuals.justification: Term order is incidental; source tutorial defines coefficients in natural variable order.
